description: Main window only: app_info; playlist import (fetch a user-supplied http(s) M3U address, or parse text from a file the user picked); HLS playback sessions (open_stream returns only an opaque kstream address; close_stream ends it); saved sources (load_sources, save_sources: one Rust-owned file in the app's data folder, validated on every save); XMLTV guides (fetch_guide downloads a user-supplied http(s) guide through the same guarded client; import_guide_file parses bytes of a file the user picked; load_guide, guide_channels, guide_programmes and remove_guide read or delete only Kinora's own guide caches). No filesystem, shell, HTTP, dialog or other plugin access.
